_comment_live_usage: Refresh official usage data. Codex uses its local app-server; Claude uses its authenticated web endpoint. Set a source to false to rely on that CLI's local cache only. Intervals are in seconds (minimum 60).
_comment_codex_prices: USD per 1M tokens: [input, output, cached_input_multiplier]. Empty = show tokens only.
_comment_claude_prices: Optional overrides, same shape. Built-in table already covers current Claude models.
_comment_discord: Optional Discord bot. Keep the bot token in the named environment variable, never in this file.
